sections.heading: Our commitment
body: Real Broker, LLC wants everyone to be able to use Cribstop.com, including people with disabilities.
We work to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA.

sections.heading: What we do
body: We design pages to work with a keyboard, a screen reader and browser zoom. We aim for clear text contrast and readable layouts on phones, tablets and computers.
We check new pages and features for accessibility when we build them.

sections.heading: Known limits
body: Some content comes from other sources, such as listing photos and descriptions from Bright MLS, and map tools from providers. We cannot always control how accessible this content is.
We work to fix accessibility problems when we find them.

sections.heading: Tell us about a problem
body: If you have trouble using any part of the site, or you need information in another format, write to contact@cribstop.com.
Tell us the page, what went wrong and the tool you use, if any. We will work with you to give you the information or service you need.
